verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar is documented as evaluating transactions in real time with AI algorithms to assess fraud risk, which covers the machine-learning screening half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents writing custom block, review, or allow rules, or exposing a per-transaction risk score to the user. missing for 10: documented custom rule authoring (block/review/allow), visible ML risk scores per transaction, a manual review queue workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
